stationary_row_normalization: per row median of all 1048576 native channels
stationary_baseline: 501-channel running median of mean row-normalized power, nearest endpoint mode
stationary_score: width-mean origin excess minus greatest adjacent control width-mean within +/-32 channels
drift_reference: each ON own first integration midpoint; actual header times for crossscan profiles
drift_preprocess: unchanged detector per-core row normalization, 501-channel median, empirical MAD and winsorized location
profile_normalization: reuse full-chunk row medians from stationary phase, no frequency/drift/width adjustment
profile_flank: median of offsets with absolute channel offset >3 within +/-64, each row
input_contract: ACQUISITION_RESULT.json complete six compact H5 files represented by decoded_files, per-file and all16row hashes
stationary_checkpoint: each origin saved with all full signed width1/width3 maps and rank list
drift_checkpoint: each scan/core saved with all4096 carrier maxima, drift/width winners and valid counts; no reruns
limitations: One historical six-scan visit; scan labels epoch1/2/3 do not represent independent visits
Stationary family covers 1048010 eligible carriers per scan, preserving all six directions
Drift family covers 32 separated cores, not the full frequency chunk
All ranks and fixed profiles are descriptive; positive row counts and robust scores are not calibrated probabilities
